variables.name: Air temperature
variables.definition: How warm the air is near the ground, averaged over the month.

variables.name: Daily highest temperature
variables.definition: The hottest reading of each day, averaged over the month.

variables.name: Daily lowest temperature
variables.definition: The coldest reading of each day, usually at night, averaged over the month.

variables.name: Ground surface temperature
variables.definition: How warm the ground or sea surface itself is, not the air above it.

variables.name: Dew point
variables.definition: The temperature at which the air would be full of water vapour and dew would form, so a higher dew point means muggier air.

variables.name: Rainfall
variables.definition: Rain and snow, as the depth of water that falls in a day.
variables.giovanni: MERRA-2 M2TMNXFLX · PRECTOTCORR (kg m-2 s-1; × 86400 = mm/day)

variables.name: Root-zone soil wetness
variables.definition: How wet the soil is where roots reach: 0 is completely dry, 1 is saturated.

variables.name: Topsoil wetness
variables.definition: How wet the top few centimetres of soil are: 0 is completely dry, 1 is soaked.

variables.name: Evaporation from land
variables.definition: How much water rises from soil and plants into the air each day, measured as a depth of water.

variables.name: Relative humidity
variables.definition: How much water vapour the air holds, as a percent of the most it could hold.
variables.giovanni: none: NASA POWER computes it; the closest MERRA-2 field is M2TMNXSLV · QV2M

variables.name: Specific humidity
variables.definition: How many grams of water vapour there are in each kilogram of air near the ground.

variables.name: Wind speed at 2 m
variables.definition: Average wind speed near the ground.
variables.giovanni: none: NASA POWER computes it from MERRA-2 M2TMNXSLV · U2M and V2M

variables.name: Wind speed at 10 m
variables.definition: Average wind speed at the height of a weather mast, 10 m above the ground.
variables.giovanni: none: NASA POWER computes it from MERRA-2 M2TMNXSLV · U10M and V10M

variables.name: Air pressure at the surface
variables.definition: How hard the air above presses down on the ground, which is lower high up on a mountain.

variables.name: Cloud cover
variables.definition: The share of the sky covered by cloud, averaged over the month.
variables.giovanni: closest: MERRA-2 M2TMNXRAD · CLDTOT (NASA POWER uses satellite cloud data)

variables.name: Sunlight reaching the ground
variables.definition: Solar energy arriving at the ground in a day, with clouds counted.
variables.giovanni: closest: MERRA-2 M2TMNXRAD · SWGDN (NASA POWER uses CERES satellite data)

variables.name: Snow depth
variables.definition: How deep the snow on the ground is, averaged over the month.

variables.name: Water vapour in the whole air column
variables.definition: All the water vapour in the air above a spot, as if it fell as a layer of water (1 kg per square metre is 1 mm).

variables.name: Haze (aerosol optical depth)
variables.definition: How much dust, smoke and pollution dim the sunlight passing through the air, where 0 means perfectly clear.
